items: Listen together got a bunch of stuff to keep it fair when there's a few of you

the host has room settings now: shuffle, repeat (queue or one song), take turns (one song from each person in rotation), and who's allowed to skip, play/pause, add songs, move or remove other people's songs, and invite

skipping is a vote by default. if you added the song (or you're the host) Next skips straight away. anyone else's Next is a vote, and more than half the room skips it. with just two of you, one vote does it
you see who voted as a little message, and the room card shows "1 of 2 votes to skip"
every song in the room queue shows the picture of whoever added it
Invite people button in the room: pick accounts and they get a notification. tapping it opens the room's join screen
Friends: if someone's in a room, their row has a Join button

blocks.text: invites only come through while the app is open or music is playing in the background. a fully closed app gets them next time it opens
the update sheet will offer it. the server needs the new version too (it updates itself after the push)

items: stats: a new listening stats page. top songs, artists and albums, plus how much you've listened

items: fetch ahead: while you have signal, the app now saves the song that's playing and the next 3 in your queue to the phone, so they keep playing when you ride into a dead zone. they show up under Downloads, Cached
Settings, Downloads has a new "Fetch ahead" row: Off, 1, 3, 5 or 10 songs. it uses mobile data too, and it fills the cache of played songs, so a small cache size means older songs get dropped sooner
with data saver on, it saves the smaller copy
it doesn't run inside a Listen together room
download queue: pause, resume or stop any single song from the queue panel on the Downloads tab, and "See all" opens the whole queue. stopping asks first
albums and playlists on the Downloads tab and their pages now show how much space they take
Settings, Downloads has a new "Wi-Fi only" switch. off by default. when it's on, downloads wait for Wi-Fi and carry on when you connect

blocks.text: the update sheet will offer it. no server update needed

items: sleep timer: tap the moon at the top of Now playing and pick 15, 30, 45, 60 or 90 minutes, or "end of current song". when it runs out the music fades out over about 10 seconds and pauses, and your queue stays so you can carry on tomorrow. in a Listen together room the timer takes only your phone out of the room, everyone else keeps listening
Settings, Account has a new "Log out everywhere" for accounts. it logs out every device signed in as you, and any link made to move your account

smart playlists: on the Playlists tab, tap "New smart playlist" and describe what you want in rules, like "I last played it more than 60 days ago" or "I liked it, and I played it fewer than 3 times". it fills itself every time you open it, using only your own plays and likes, and nobody else can see it
while you edit the rules a box under them shows how many songs they pick right now, so you can tune them before saving
on a smart playlist, the ⋮ menu has Edit rules and Save as playlist (turns what it picks today into a normal playlist you can edit by hand)
"Random" order keeps the same order all day, so reopening or downloading it doesn't reshuffle, and gives you a new mix tomorrow
you can't add songs to a smart playlist by hand, and it doesn't show up in Add to playlist

blocks.text: the update sheet will offer it. smart playlists need the matching server update, which goes out with it

items: headset buttons: Settings > Playback > Headset buttons lets you pick what one, two or three presses do, plus what the Next and Previous buttons do. options are play or pause, next, previous, skip 10 seconds forward or back, or nothing

items: songs you play now get saved on your phone (a cache), so playing them again uses no data and they work offline too
offline? check the new "Cached" filter in Downloads, everything you've played fully is there. songs in your queue that are cached won't get skipped anymore when you lose signal
pick how big the cache can get in Settings > Downloads: 500 MB, 1 GB (default), 2 GB, 5 GB or unlimited. when it's full the stuff you played longest ago goes first. there's a clear cache button too
downloading a song you already played is instant now, it copies from the cache

items: volume levelling: songs now play at about the same loudness, so no more grabbing the volume when a loud track follows a quiet one
it's on by default. turn it off in settings, under the fades

the server has to measure every song first, which takes a while on a big library. songs you've played recently go first, and anything you play jumps the line, so it's levelled from the next time it comes up
downloaded songs keep their levelling offline. songs downloaded before this update play as before until you download them again
heads up: most of the library is mastered loud, so with levelling on things get quieter overall. turn your phone up a bit

items: **Two ways in.** The start screen now has **Log in** and **Guest** buttons. Log in shows the username and password form. Guest lets you in without an account; if the server asks for a guest code, a box appears for it. Codes look like `ABCD-EFGH` and work in upper or lower case, with or without the dash.
**Guests can listen and search.** Guests don't build up play counts, and leaving as a guest asks first, because the phone forgets that guest for good.
**Signed for updates.** From this version the app is signed with its own release key, so future versions install straight over this one.

blocks.text: Browse songs, albums, artists and genres with an A to Z rail, search, background playback with lock-screen and notification controls, shuffle (spread across artists), repeat, an endless queue with Play next, a Now Playing screen with a choice of seek bar styles, resume where you left off, and System / Light / Dark themes.
If you installed the app before this release, uninstall it first: the old builds were signed with a different key, so Android won't update over them. Then install this one and log in again.
